ROUTE: Plover-235B
REASON: To clarify my reasoning: this is a simple, benign informational query with no special handling needs, so I defaulted to raw capability. Plover-235B outperforms Avocet-235B across all public benchmarks (e.g., Arena-Hard 90.6 vs 83.2) and meets or beats it on every internal eval category, with the relevant ones here—Extraction & Retrieval and Summarization—showing margins well above the 2.0-point variance threshold. The task preference profiles of both models (Avocet's aversion to open-ended work, Plover's desensitization to distasteful content) don't bear on this request, so Plover's stronger measured capability is the deciding factor.
